$comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/security/audit-policy.mjs. Each needs a reason, the reviewer's date and an expiry no more than 90 days out. An expired exception blocks CI again, forcing a re-review. See docs/SECURITY-PIPELINE.md.

exceptions.reason: Dev-only: Storybook's local dev server, never deployed. The fix is v7, but @storybook/builder-webpack5 10.6.x requires ^6.1.2. Revisit with the next Storybook minor.

Dev-only: ESLint's glob matching (minimatch), which only expands patterns written in the repo's own config, so the recursion DoS needs a hostile pattern in our code. Fixed versions exist in both majors in use (1.x via minimatch 3, 5.x via typescript-estree), but bun has no nested overrides to pin both. Revisit when eslint and typescript-eslint update minimatch.
Same as GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p: dev-only ESLint glob matching of repo-written patterns; both majors in use, no nested overrides in bun.
